Offerings Aromas Boutique Plans Our Story {{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}}

Nurturing balance through intentional aromatherapy

Thoughtful, safety-forward consultations and plant-powered blends tailored to your lifestyle. Hybrid sessions available in {{CITY}}, {{STATE}} and online.

{{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}} Explore blends

Quick intake

5-min wellness snapshot to prepare your hybrid session with {{PRACTITIONER_NAME}}.

  • Personal preferences & scent history
  • Allergies & safety considerations
  • Goals & daily routines
Book a session

Why aromatherapy, carefully applied

At {{BUSINESS_NAME}}, we center safety and evidence-based best practices. Our approach emphasizes informed choice, proper dilution, and patch testing—so you can enjoy aromatic support without guesswork. We do not offer medical diagnoses; our guidance supports everyday comfort and routines.

Sessions are hybrid: in-person consultations in {{CITY}}, {{STATE}}, and remote appointments for distance clients.

Meet your practitioner

{{PRACTITIONER_NAME}} — certified aromatherapist focused on practical blends that integrate into daily life. Special interest in gentle formulations for people, with pet- and pregnancy-conscious guidance.

Learn more

Our process — considered, clear, collaborative

1

Intake

We collect scent history, sensitivities, medication and pregnancy status to ensure safety-first recommendations.

2

Assessment

We review goals and environmental factors (home, pets) and discuss practical dilution and application options.

3

Blend & plan

Receive a tailored blend, usage guidance, and follow-up resources for patch testing and safe storage.

How we can work together

Flexible options to suit schedules and preferences.

Hybrid Consultation

Combination of an online intake and an in-person aroma assessment in {{CITY}}, {{STATE}}. Includes a single bespoke 10–15 mL blend and usage plan.

Virtual Session

Fully remote session with guided scent sampling and a post-session recipe for DIY blends, including safe dilution and storage instructions.

Follow-up & Care

Short check-ins to refine blends and address sensory changes. Ideal for seasonal shifts or lifestyle updates.

Pricing snapshot

Starter

$95

Virtual intake + 5 mL sample blend

See details

Hybrid

$160

Intake + in-person assessment + 15 mL bespoke blend

Choose Hybrid

Follow-up

15-min check-in for refinements and troubleshooting

Book follow-up

Client reflections

"I appreciated the careful guidance—dilution and patch testing were explained clearly. The blend feels like an extension of my routine."— A. in {{CITY}}
"Practical, grounded, and gentle. I use my roll-on nightly; the scent is subtle and supportive."— K. (remote client)
"Responsive to questions about pets and pregnancy-safe options. Felt heard and informed."— M. in {{STATE}}

Ready to explore scent with care?

Schedule a hybrid consultation or request a virtual intake—either way, we prioritize safe, practical aromatherapy.
